facts.why: In the script the judge calls Philip Green the president of Tangiers Corporation, and Wikipedia calls him the frontman. Ace serves at the pleasure of the chairman of the board, so Green is the president rather than the chairman.

facts.text: Cheats leave by the back door.
facts.why: None of the sources I opened give Ace a back door rule for cheats. The only back door scene in the script is Ginger's, with thugs following a man out.
facts.fix: Cheats don't get a second chance.

facts.text: Dry martini -- at the craps table
facts.why: I could not find a martini or a craps table scene tied to a martini in the script or the plot.
facts.fix: Dry martini -- for the high rollers

vibe.verdict: The Tangiers coffee shop menu leans on the blueberry muffin scene well, and the rules list is the best part. It misses Ginger, Nicky and the skim.
missing: Ginger throwing chips from the car (the lobby)
The Aku-Aku Lounge where Ace compares muffins
Nicky Santoro and the vice (the pen)
